pob_baseline.whole_verse_english: I will walk among you and will be your God[a], and you will be my people.

assessment.greek_pronoun_variant: μοι (dative) versus μου (genitive); do not omit this smaller distinction
assessment.earliest_greek_priority: unresolved; Himbaza argues ethnos earlier, Wevers2005 leaves Rahlfs unchanged because both nouns can represent עם and usage is inconclusive
assessment.hebrew_reconstruction: retain current עם; this comparison does not establish a distinct Hebrew Vorlage, and does not warrant retroverting גוי
assessment.english: retain my people for this locus; a Greek-source edition could expose ethnos as nation/people with apparatus, but this is not a compulsory correction of Hebrew-based POB
assessment.context: Leviticus26:11–13 checked in current POB and pinned Greek; presence, covenant relation and deliverance context retained. No adjudication of 26:11 dwelling/covenant difference or 26:12 opening-clause omission/transposition.
assessment.source_disagreement: The synoptic full noun is not a survival claim: use εθν[ος], with ending supplied, for preservation-sensitive display.
assessment.incidental_note_anchor: POB v12 [a] follows God but explains walk in your midst. Reported to parent; no canonical correction applied.
